title: Plasma Wave Interference Shader
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that renders an interactive plasma wave interference shader on a full-screen quad. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Use an OrthographicCamera looking at a full-screen quad (PlaneGeometry(2,2)) so the custom shader fills the entire viewport.
- No additional lights are needed since the shader handles all coloring.
- Set renderer background to black, enable antialiasing.

## Shader Details
- Write a custom ShaderMaterial with vertex and fragment shaders.
- The fragment shader must implement a plasma effect using the interference of exactly 3 sine wave sources.
- Each wave source has a 2D position (vec2), a frequency (float), and an amplitude (float).
- The plasma value at each pixel is computed as: plasma = sum_i( amplitude_i * sin(frequency_i * distance(uv, source_i) - time * speed) ) where speed controls animation rate.
- Map the plasma value to color using: r = sin(plasma * 3.0) * 0.5 + 0.5, g = sin(plasma * 3.0 + 2.094) * 0.5 + 0.5, b = sin(plasma * 3.0 + 4.189) * 0.5 + 0.5 (phase offsets of 2π/3).
- Pass uniforms: u_time (float), u_speed (float, default 1.0), u_sources (vec2 array[3]), u_frequencies (float array[3]), u_amplitudes (float array[3]), u_paused (bool, default false).
- Default wave sources: source0=(0.3, 0.3), source1=(0.7, 0.6), source2=(0.5, 0.8). Default frequencies: [8.0, 12.0, 10.0]. Default amplitudes: [1.0, 0.8, 0.6].

## User Interactions
- Press SPACE to toggle pause/unpause the animation (stop incrementing u_time).
- Press 'R' to reset all parameters to defaults (sources, frequencies, amplitudes, speed, unpause, time=0).
- Press '1', '2', '3' to select the active wave source (default: source 1 selected).
- When a source is selected, clicking on the canvas moves that source to the clicked UV coordinate.
- Press UP/DOWN arrow keys to increase/decrease the frequency of the selected source by 1.0 (clamp to [1.0, 30.0]).
- Press LEFT/RIGHT arrow keys to decrease/increase the animation speed by 0.25 (clamp to [0.25, 5.0]).
- Press 'A' to toggle amplitude mode: cycle the selected source's amplitude through [0.0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0] in order, wrapping around.

## HUD / UI
- Display a HUD overlay (div, id='hud', top-left, white text on semi-transparent black background, font-family monospace, font-size 14px, padding 10px, z-index 100, pointer-events none).
- HUD shows: 'Source: {1|2|3}', 'Freq: {freq}', 'Amp: {amp}', 'Speed: {speed}', 'Paused: {yes|no}' each on its own line.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - paused (bool)
  - time (float, current u_time value)
  - speed (float)
  - selectedSource (int, 1-3)
  - sources (array of 3 objects {x, y})
  - frequencies (array of 3 floats)
  - amplitudes (array of 3 floats)
  - amplitudeCycleIndex (array of 3 ints, index into [0.0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0])
  - frameCount (int, incremented each animation frame)
  - shaderCompiled (bool, true if material compiled without errors)

## Animation Loop
- Use requestAnimationFrame. If not paused, increment u_time by delta * speed each frame. Always increment frameCount.
physics_constraints: Wave interference must be additive (superposition principle). Frequencies clamped [1.0, 30.0]. Speed clamped [0.25, 5.0]. Amplitudes cycle through discrete set [0.0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0]. Time must not advance when paused. Source positions must stay within [0,1] UV range.
